latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor Test — Test and Export Edited Videos.

- Upload raw video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) for quick cloud-based editing and export.
- Describe the edit you want (e.g., "trim unnecessary parts, add transitions") and get a 1080p MP4 download in 1-2 minutes.
- Automatic setup via NEMO_TOKEN or anonymous session; minimal user configuration required.
- Supports common editing tasks: trim, transitions, text overlays, audio tracks, and export.
- Designed for content creators and marketers seeking a fast, easy trial of AI-driven video editing.
